item.title: Nyuu wa SHOCK!! ~Pai o Torimodose!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Studio Ebisu
  • 発売日: 2005-12-16
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 乳はSHOCK!! パイを取り戻せ!
  • 英語名: Nyuu wa SHOCK!! Pai o Torimodose!

あらすじ

Kentarou inherited from his father “Bus-to Shinken”, an ancient martial arts tenchnique that allows to change opponent’s bust size by striking at certain body points. However, his flat-chested step-sister Rao has sworn to eliminate all boobs in the world using this technique. Obviously, Kentarou can’t permit such travesty to materialize, so the fateful showdown is about to ensue!

  • 英語名: Nozokimi Yuurei!!

别名

  • Nozokimi Yu~rei!!

あらすじ

Main character dies in an accident. However, he is not allowed to the heavens under pretext that not all ties with earthly world have been cut yet. He is given two months. He asks himself what he always desired to do most of all - to lose virginity! He is going to use all his powers as a ghost to reach his goal.
